changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_recipient_count check (recipient_count between 1 and 10)
alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_section check (includes_donors or includes_donations or includes_unpaired_payments or includes_bank_import)

alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_donors check ( (includes_donors and registered_donors is not null and new_donors is not null and new_donors between 0 and registered_donors) or (not includes_donors and registered_donors is null and new_donors is null))

alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_donations check ( (includes_donations and received_count >= 0 and received_total_minor >= 0 and paired_count >= 0 and paired_total_minor >= 0 and received_in_year_count >= 0 and received_in_year_total_minor >= 0) or (not includes_donations and received_count is null and received_total_minor is null and paired_count is null and paired_total_minor is null and received_in_year_count is null and received_in_year_total_minor is null))

alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_unpaired check ( (includes_unpaired_payments and unpaired_count >= 0 and unpaired_total_minor >= 0) or (not includes_unpaired_payments and unpaired_count is null and unpaired_total_minor is null))

alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_bank_import check ( includes_bank_import or (bank_last_succeeded_at is null and bank_last_failure_at is null and bank_last_failure_kind is null))
alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_failure check ((bank_last_failure_at is null) = (bank_last_failure_kind is null))

alter table donation_report_delivery add constraint ck_donation_report_delivery_failure_kind check ( bank_last_failure_kind in ('RATE_LIMITED', 'HISTORY_LOCKED', 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'TRANSPORT', 'INVALID_RESPONSE', 'UNEXPECTED'))
